scope: Current prepared source/frontend with Android presentation. Actual local HTTP APIs, isolated in-memory stores plus actual disposable MongoDB replica; not certification of the installed/public APK or physical hardware.

findings.title: Online sale amount validation is incomplete
findings.customerImpact: Incorrect revenue/change can be recorded by an authenticated checkout request. Native offline-cash validation is a separate path.
findings.acceptance: Recompute/validate line totals; require sufficient finite received cash; bound discount/tax and forbid negative/nonfinite totals.

findings.title: Online sale accepts unavailable or foreign product references
findings.customerImpact: Invalid products become paid sales without a matching store stock deduction. This did not expose or modify the other store product.
findings.acceptance: Validate every product belongs to the store, exists, and is saleable before payment/order mutations.

findings.title: Online checkout silently oversells stock
findings.customerImpact: A sale at stock 0 leaves stock -1 without a warning. Preserve explicit historical offline-sale reconciliation separately.
findings.acceptance: Use an explicit stock policy with atomic availability checks or a clear recorded override/warning.

findings.title: Online checkout has no retry idempotency
findings.customerImpact: The same keyed request creates two orders and deducts stock twice. Electronic provider duplication is a risk, not a tested charge.
findings.acceptance: Persist a checkout attempt key, reuse provider reference and order across retries, and test response-loss recovery.

findings.title: Order storage failure leaves stock deducted
findings.customerImpact: Injected insert failures leave stock 9 with zero orders instead of rolling back to 10.
findings.acceptance: Commit local order/inventory effects atomically and reconcile external payment intents after failures.

findings.title: Concurrent void restores stock repeatedly
findings.customerImpact: Eight actual HTTP cancellations on real MongoDB left stock above its original 10 units.
findings.acceptance: Use a guarded atomic status transition plus exactly-once stock restoration; concurrent requests must restore only once.

findings.title: Voided orders can be marked paid again
findings.customerImpact: Stock stays restored while the sale reappears in paid revenue.
evidence: A voided sale cannot be marked paid again without restoring stock accounting
findings.acceptance: Enforce legal payment state transitions, including manual actions and late provider callbacks.

findings.title: Purchase order product lines are discarded
findings.customerImpact: Selected products, quantities and costs are not persisted; an order cannot support accurate receiving.
evidence: Creating a purchase preserves its selected product and quantity
findings.acceptance: Persist validated product/quantity/cost lines and verify them after saving and reloading.

findings.title: Receiving changes status but does not add inventory
findings.customerImpact: Five units received leave stock 10 instead of 15; a nonexistent PO can also get a successful receipt.
evidence: Receiving a purchase changes actual stock rather than only its status
findings.acceptance: Validate the PO and remaining line quantities, update inventory atomically, and prevent duplicate receiving.

findings.title: Supplier invoice and payable statuses diverge
findings.customerImpact: Paying via Hutang leaves the invoice Unpaid; reopening an invoice leaves the debt Paid.
findings.acceptance: Use a shared linked settlement record and update both screens consistently for partial/full/reversed payments.

findings.title: Stock adjustments can succeed without changing the selected product
findings.customerImpact: An SKU-less product sends N/A and stays at stock 10 after an add-5 success. Negative quantities and a forged author are also accepted.
findings.acceptance: Identify the store product by ID, validate a positive quantity/type, require a matched update, and derive actor from auth.

findings.title: Debt endpoints allow overpayment
findings.customerImpact: A Rp1000 payable accepts paid_amount Rp2000 without rejection.
findings.acceptance: Validate finite nonnegative debt/payment amounts, cap settlement to the balance, and derive status from the ledger.

findings.title: Stock movement shows invented business transactions
findings.customerImpact: A fresh store displays Kopi Arabika 250g, ORD-1002 and other default movements that never occurred.
evidence: Stock movement on a new store contains no invented sales or purchases
findings.acceptance: Remove demo entries and use a complete server-backed movement ledger with real receipts, adjustments, sales and reversals.

findings.title: Load errors still look like empty or healthy data on eight screens
findings.customerImpact: HTTP 503 is hidden on dashboard, stock movement, purchase orders/receiving/invoices, customers, suppliers and branches.
findings.acceptance: Distinguish loading/error/valid empty/success and offer retry; do not save defaults after failed configuration reads.

findings.title: Adjustment, transfer and purchase selectors still stop at product 500
findings.customerImpact: Product 501 is available in the catalogue but cannot be chosen in three workflows.
findings.acceptance: Use complete catalogue enumeration or searchable server selectors with explicit paging.

findings.title: Customer, supplier and unpaid invoice lists silently truncate
findings.customerImpact: Real Mongo returns 200/201 customers, 100/106 suppliers and 100/101 unpaid invoices, with no continuation or count boundary.
findings.acceptance: Provide store-scoped search/pagination and visible complete counts, including older unpaid bills.

findings.title: Warehouse stock movement requests a forbidden POS endpoint
findings.customerImpact: The permitted inventory screen requests /orders?limit=100, gets 403, then leaves its sample movement list.
findings.acceptance: Serve inventory movement through inventory.read and keep sale-history/credential permissions separate.

findings.title: Today totals use UTC instead of the store timezone
findings.customerImpact: A paid sale at 23:00 UTC / 06:00 WIB on the current store day is missing from today_sales.
findings.acceptance: Apply the configured IANA store timezone to day boundaries and test WIB/WITA/WIT midnight transitions.

findings.title: Historical profit changes when current product cost changes
findings.customerImpact: Recorded net profit changed from Rp600 to Rp200 after editing current cost. This is an existing documented approximation.
findings.acceptance: Snapshot cost on new sale lines; use explicit approximation/unknown handling for legacy sales rather than rewriting history.

findings.title: Saved loyalty earning rules do not award sale points
findings.customerImpact: A matched customer buying Rp1000 under a saved Rp1000=1 point rule remains at zero points.
findings.acceptance: Persist the customer ID on sales and apply earning/reversal/redemption rules exactly once, or clearly describe manual-only points.

findings.title: Transfers are record-only and lack basic validation
findings.customerImpact: A transfer between the same nonexistent branch with quantity -5 is accepted as Shipped; schema stores product names, without branch balances or a receiving workflow.
findings.acceptance: Validate store branch/product IDs and positive quantities; implement shipment/receipt/reversal inventory effects or label this as a transfer log.

apiDiagnostics.limitation: AsyncMongoMock does not enforce to_list(length) like real MongoDB. Real-Mongo list results supersede the small in-memory list passes; these passes do not certify complete datasets.

androidLint.note: Warnings reviewed; RequiresFeature calls are guarded by the common feature check and are not counted as confirmed crashes.
